fields.name: limit
fields.description: Maximum items to return per page. Range: 1-50, default 20.

fields.name: offset
fields.description: Number of items to skip for pagination. Default 0.

fields.name: type
fields.description: Filter results by angel number pattern type. "repeating" returns numbers like 111, 444, 7777. "sequential" returns patterns like 1234. "mirror" returns palindrome or alternating patterns like 1212, 717. "master" returns 11, 22, 33. "root" returns single digits 0-9. "compound" returns mixed sequences with no pure pattern like 911, 1122.
